title: 2021 HMMT February Guts Problem 3
statement: A semicircle with radius 2021 has diameter \(A B\) and center \(O\). Points \(C\) and \(D\) lie on the semicircle such that \(\angle A O C<\angle A O D=90^{\circ}\). A circle of radius \(r\) is inscribed in the sector bounded by \(O A\) and \(O C\) and is tangent to the semicircle at \(E\). If \(C D=C E\), compute \(\lfloor r\rfloor\).

solutions.text:
We are given

\[m \angle E O C=m \angle C O D\]

and

\[m \angle A O C+m \angle C O D=2 m \angle E O C+m \angle C O D=90^{\circ} .\]

So \(m \angle E O C=30^{\circ}\) and \(m \angle A O C=60^{\circ}\). Letting the radius of the semicircle be \(R\), we have

\[(R-r) \sin \angle A O C=r \Rightarrow r=\frac{1}{3} R\]

so

\[\lfloor r\rfloor=\left\lfloor\frac{2021}{3}\right\rfloor=673\]
